entities.summary: Dazhao Temple, also known as the Hongci or Wuliang Temple and as the Ih Juu, is a Tibetan Buddhist monastery of the Gelugpa order in the city of Hohhot in Inner Mongolia in North China. It is the oldest and largest temple in the city and is located West of Danan Street in the Yuquan District.
